tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dgyes pa rdo rje yum bka'i cho ga dngos grub sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// kun la rjes brtses kun chags pa'i// thams cad skad kyi thams cad dbyangs// sgyu 'phrul gar nas sgyu 'phrul du// len mkhas snying po len gtsor 'dud// 'dir dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i yum bka' bdag med lha mo bco lnga bsgom par 'dod pas/ bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las phyag rgya sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob cing*/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i rgyud dag pa'i gang zag gis sgrub pa'i cha rkyen ma tshang ba med par byas te/ gnas khang byi dor dang*/ mchod rdzas kyis brgyan pa'i gung du/ dam tshig gi bris sku tshad ldan rab gnas byas pa bkram/ mdun du stegs bu'i khar maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma sogs bshams/ sgrub pa po stan bzang po la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'khod pa'i mdun du/ g.yon nas brtsams te bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru dang rdo rje dril bu rnams bkod/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ 'kho ba'i nyer spyad rnams tshang bar byas la/ badz+ra āt+ma/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying gar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med ma 'khor gyi lha mos mchod pa byed bzhin pa dang*/ shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i gau ri ma nag mos bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ de zin pa'i brdar se gol gcig gtog oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsau ri ma dmar mos pad+ma rak+tas thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bai tā li ser mos bdud rtsi dri chus thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

ghasma rī ljang khus bdud rtsi dri chen gyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam / oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ puk+ka si sngon mos sha sna tshogs kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sha wa rī dkar mos bdud rtsi sbrang chang gis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam / oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mos cang te'u'i sgras mchod par bsam / oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ḍom+bi ni khra mos snyoms 'jug gis mchod par bsam mo// yan lag lhag ma drug yid kyis bsgom zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog ces lan gsum/ he badz+ra man+ḍal muḥtshogs gsog pa'i rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ dgra med gnyen med bshes med zun med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// rang gi snying kha'i a las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud la bsdu/ de rang gi lus la bsdu/ de yas 'dus mas 'dus pa las snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la thim/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ de a la/ de yang rim gyis 'dus nas nā da'i rnam pa lta bu las/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

nā da las rang sgra byung bar bsam mo// bzhi pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni// de nas rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi me'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi me'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnams bkag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas brtan par mos/ lnga pa chos 'byung ni/ de'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ drug pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ bdun pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ de'i dbus su pad 'dab bzhi/ de'i phyi rol tu brgyad/ lte ba nag po/ ze'u 'bru khra bo/ 'dab ma rnams dmar po/ gong ras nag po/ thod 'phreng dkar po/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pas bskor ba'i lte ba dang 'dab ma steng 'og tu ro gan rkyal tu bsgyel ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

gdan so so'i steng du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥtshar gcig brjod pas/ ā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de mngon par byang chub pa na dang po/ ye shes ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥtshar gcig brjod pas de'i steng du kā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de mngon par byang chub pa ni gnyis pa/ ye shes ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su a/ nang gi pad+ma'i rnams la ā i ī u/ phyi ma'i pad+ma'i byang shar nas g.yas skor ba'i mtshams bzhir/ ū ṛ ṝ l̥/ phyogs su l̥̄ e ai o/ 'og dang steng du au aṃḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las zangs kyi gri gug sa bon so sos mtshan pa/ de mngon par byang chub pa na gsum pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de nas nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan rnams 'dres pa la nam mkha'i nā da zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen por gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de ni mngon par byang chub pa na bzhi pa/ ye shes ni/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai tā lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha ba rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad sku mdog nag mo/ khro ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/

dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon par brten pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swabhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ byang chub pa lnga pa// ye shes na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la so so'i sa bon 'od zer dang bcas pa gtso mo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i ā las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/

oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo puk+ka sī gau rī rnams la mi bskyod pa/

rdo rje ma ri khrod ma chom rkun ma sa spyod ma rnams la rnam snang*/ dkar mo gdol pa mo ro langs ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma ḍom+bo nī ghasma rī mkha' spyod ma rnams la snang mtha'/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan nas gnyis su med par gyur/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyis bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/

de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum/ puk+ka sī dang gau ri ma la mi bskyod pa/ sha wa rī dang tsau rī ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang bai tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍom+bi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go /bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha rnams kyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/ de rnams kyis lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/ bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yaṃ= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= ces mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang nas bdag dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la bstod par gyur/ don yod grub pa'i yan lag go mos pa sna tshogs gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir// chos dbyings mi bskyod 'gag pa med pa las// thabs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa// ye shes thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid ā las skyes// bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa 'jigs pa sku// mi bskyod dbu brgyan bde ba chen po'i sku// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ā las skyes pa'i mdzes ma rdo rje ma// rtag tu dgyes pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la gzigs// gdug pa rnams skrag rnam snang cod pan thogs// dur khrod rgyan dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// i las byung ba gsang ba'i gau ri ma// gzi brjid mi mtshungs gar ldan ro mchog myong*// don dam thugs chud dbu rgyan rin chen tog

/spyan gsum thod rlon can la phyag 'tshal lo// ā li kā li'i snyoms 'jug rnal 'byor ma// bde la rtag dgyes byang chub sems kyi ngang*// 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan ī las skyes// gar gyis dgyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// u las byung ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// khams gsum dag byed sgrol ma las kyi mchog /don grub dbu rgyan chags pa'i spyan dang ldan// mtshungs med chags par ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med chos dbyings rnam dag puk+ka sī// mi bskyod dbu rgyan dri ma dag mdzad cing*// ū las skyes pa brgya phyed 'phreng ba'i 'dzin// 'jig rten zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'dus ma byas pa'i ri khrod ma// spros bral dri med rnam snang dbu la bzhugs// ṛ las 'khrungs pa gar gyis phyogs bcur gzigs// chu zla dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas dang nye gnas la sogs bgrod mdzad cing*// 'du byed ma lus srog mdzad tsaṇ+ḍā lī// rin chen dbu brgyan brjid pas ṝ las skyes// 'jig ma gsal mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje skyed mdzad g.yo ba'i ḍom+bi nī// sgeg mo snang mtha' dbu rgyan l̥ las byung*// mkha' ltar dri med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu drag po'i brda yis skad sbyor zhing*// ru dhi ra dang an+d+ra la rtag dgyes// zhe sdang rdo rje'i dbu rgyan l̥̄ las skyes// gau rī phyogs bcur gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings gsal ba'i yum gyur chom rkun ma// mi rtog mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i don la brtson// dbu rgyan gti mug rdo rje mi 'gyur rtags// e las skyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten ma lus chags pas dbang du mdzad// dpal ldan gzi brjid bskyed mdzad baitā lī// nga rgyal rdo rjes dbu brgyan e las skyes// snyoms 'jug mi gnas ngang la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab thabs su ldan pa'i ghasma rī// de nyid las skyes 'dod chags rdo rje'i brgyan// o las byung ba drag po'i las las skyes// skye med skye bar bstan la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyu ma smig rgyu bzhin du mkha' la spyod// bar snang mnga' mdzad he ru ka yi ngang*// cod pan snang ba mtha' yas au las skyes// thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan sa 'og spyod// 'og gi 'jig rten ma lus sgrol mdzad ma// aṃ las byung ba'i dur khrod 'jigs pas brgyan// thabs mkhas thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// ā li kā li zla ba nyi ma kha sbyor sa 'og rnam par dag pa las// gri gug thod pa la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan pa mdzes mdzad cing*// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar ldan gcer bu spyan gsum stag lpags sham thabs can// phyag rgya chen po'i sku ni rtsa gsum sprul mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nag phyam gyis gyur/ de nas dmar/ de nas ser ljang sngo dkar por phyam gyis gyur/ de nas sngar bzhin gsal ba/ de nas/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ nas/ gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// ces pa'i bar dang*/ 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa// sogs phyag rgya lnga'i dag pa bsgom/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ zhal nas 'thon te lte bar zhugs/ gtso mos bzlas pas 'khor rnams zlos grogs byed par bsam/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ swā hā/ zhes gtso 'khor thun mong du bzlas/ bzlas pas skyo na thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de yang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la/ de rnams kyang gtso mo'i thugs kar thim par bsgom mo/ de nas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/

gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dzā la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ āt+ma/ sarba/ kan+dza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ bi ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams mnyes nas ha ha/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥzhes ye shes kyi gad mo bcu gnyis sgrogs shing*/ sgrub pa po khyod kyi yid la ci 'dod pa bdag cag rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o zhes khas len par gyur/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams= yi dwags tshogs= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed tshogs= brjed byed tshogs= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// dbang dang mngon spyod dgra 'joms dang*// dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs shog/

ces phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥgator ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na skabs 'di nyid du gtang bar bya'o// de nas cang te'u dkrol zhing*/ kol+la i reṭ+ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī/ ga ḍeṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ du na dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tsha ri si h+la/ kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in+dha ṇa sā li dza/ ta he bhi ru kha i a i/ pheṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṅga tsa ḍi wa/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a tse kun+tu ru bā ḍa i/ ḍāṃṇ+ḍi ma ta hiṃ ṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zasacan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'o// // ༈ dkyil 'khor gyi las rim la/ sa chog sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga gsum las/ dang po la gang du sgrub pa'i gnas der mchod pa gtor ma bshams la/ sngon du 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha sogs nas/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du zhu ba dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur

zhes byin gyis brlab/ dril bu dkrol zhing ngag tu/ in+d+ra sogs sam bsdus par a kā ro nyid kyis kyang rung ste lan gsum brjod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ zhes pas 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya'i mthar muḥ zhes brjod/ se gol lan gsum gtog gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs/ gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi mos shing phyag rgya sna tshogs blta ba la mi dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di sbyin no// gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas dang rten gang yin la phar dengs shig /suṃ bha ni brjod cing rol mos bskrad/ de nas oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma kau3 haṃ/ bar gyis/ yan lag drug pa'i bskyed rim bsgom ste/ mthar rten gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha mo bcu bzhi la bsdu/ de rnams kyang gtso mo'i thugs kar thim zhing*/ de he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/

zhes dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ yab bka' yum bka' gnyis kar las kyi lha he ru ka phyag gnyis par mdzad pa rngog pa rnams kyis bzhed do// de nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i dbus su dri yi thig le gcig bya/ me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgram/ de la baṃ las sa'i lha mo lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pa/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa khas len gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ bdag gis ci bgyid zer ba cig tu gyur/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba'i// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil can// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la// dkyil 'khor las rnams rab tu sgrubs/ hrīḥhī hī hī hī baṃ swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gan+dhe= nai wid+yā= ā lo ke= shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// bdag med lha mo mchod pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur// rig 'dzin bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos/ sa'i phyogs 'dir khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bris shig ces gnang ba sbyin nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/

dam tshig sems dpa' de nyid du thim par gyur/ gsum pa bya bas sbyang ba ni/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba/ brkos la sa'i skyon lnga bsal nas stegs bu ngos rer tshon gsum gyis lhag pa'i khru gsum/ dbus cung zad mtho ba/ mtha' bags kyis dma' zhing zhal bas 'jam par byas pa/ ba'i rnam lnga'i dri bzang gis skyang nul legs par bya'o// sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa gnyis sa la bzhag la sa'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dag par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa sa srung ba ni/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus hūm̐ las ral gri de'i lte ba la hūm̐ de'i 'od zer las rdo rje rgya gram phyogs mtshams thams cad du gtams par bsam zhing*/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ brjod pas sa gzhi bsrung*/ oṃ me di ni swā hā/ ye shes kyi sa bkug nas de la bstim/ lnga pa sa gzung ba ni/ sta gon gyi phyir mchod pa dang rten bsham/ gnas nye bar brgyan par bya'o// nub dang po'i 'o// gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po bgegs bsal ba ni/ gnas der bum pa la sogs pa'i sta gon gyi yo byad dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas lag len bzhin du bshams te/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te phyi dro'i dus su in+d+ra'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa bzhin du byas nas 'khor mi bsdu bar bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ mchod g.yog pa bzhi gau rī ma sogs lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dril bu thogs/ thog mar shar nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis gau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/

oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= mchod yon sogs dang rnam lngas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// de nas bskul ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ lho phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis tsau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang dbang po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spang*// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ nub phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bai tā li ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang nye dbang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/

bskul ba ni/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ byang nas rang nyid skad cig gis ghasma rī ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang drag po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la thim zhes/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ bdag nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ mig gnyis su m dang ṭ las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor der hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje re res mtshan par gyur/ rab tu myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis blta zhing dbus su langs te nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ kha yi pad+ma 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kun+da dkar gsal so yi 'phreng*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che// sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung*// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya/ /zhes brjod la rdo rje dril bu bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas/ shar gyi phyogs nas kha nang du bstan te bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang 'da' ba// tshal par dag gis gzhan du min// bde chen ye shes rdzogs 'tshang rgya// rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes// lus srul po ni gang su dag

/bgegs chen po rnams so sor song*/ sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon 'di zhes bya bas slob ma rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhig 'bri yis/ gang su yang rung ba/ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ lha min dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ gnon po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+ṭo ka ṭa bhe ra bā ya/ oṃ da ka ta/ badz+ra san+to haṃ/ dar+pa ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ rtsa sngags kyang bzla/ de rnams lan gsum brjod cing*/ dang por rdo rje gsor/ tha mar dril bu dkrol/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te hūm̐ mang po brjod cing g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor te/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ slar yang dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas rang nyid bdag med ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal gyis hi mang po brjod cing g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ yang na dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis g.yas brkyang gis 'dug ste rdo rje dril bu gzung ba'i lag pas gar bsgyur zhing hūm̐ 'ba' zhig 'don pa dang*/ bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon brkyang gis 'dug ste hi 'ba' zhig brjod par bya'o// slar yang

rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi mo'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi mo'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnam bkag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs par bsam mo// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ stangs stabs byas pa'i sa rdul 'phyags la/ chang dang bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar bas gzhal yas khang gi tshad tsam zlum por byugs pa'i dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ de rgyab nang gi phyogs bzhi la zlum po re/ de rgyab phyogs mtshams brgyad la re re dang*/ shar nub gnyis su re re bcas/ dbus nas rim pa bzhin so so'i snying po brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgram mo// de nas mchod pa rnam lnga lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nas gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swabhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ byang chub pa lnga pa// ye shes na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la so so'i sa bon 'od zer dang bcas pa gtso mo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/

spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i ā las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/

zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum/ puk+ka sī dang gau ri ma la mi bskyod pa/ sha wa rī dang tsau rī ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang bai tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍom+bi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go /bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyis sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/

de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha snam gyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/ de rnams kyis lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/ bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yā= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ=

oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= ces mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang nas bdag dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la bstod par gyur/ don yod grub pa'i yan lag go bdud rtsi myang*/ mos pa sna tshogs gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir// chos dbyings mi bskyod 'gag pa med pa las// thabs kyi sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa// ye shes thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid ā las skyes// bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa 'jigs pa sku// mi bskyod dbu brgyan bde ba chen po'i sku// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ā las skyes pa'i mdzes ma rdo rje ma// rtag tu dgyes pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la gzigs// gdug pa rnams skrag rnam snang cod pan thogs// dur khrod rgyan dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// i las byung ba gsang ba'i gau ri ma// gzi brjid mi mtshungs gar ldan ro mchog myong*// don dam thugs chud dbu rgyan rin chen tog /spyan gsum thod rlon can la phyag 'tshal lo// ā li kā li'i snyoms 'jug rnal 'byor ma// bde la rtag dgyes byang chub sems kyi ngang*// 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan ī las skyes// gar gyis dgyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// u las byung ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// khams gsum dag byed sgrol ma las kyi mchog /don grub dbu rgyan chags pa'i spyan dang ldan// mtshungs med chags par ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med chos dbyings rnam dag puk+ka sī// mi bskyod dbu rgyan dṛ ma dag mdzad cing*// ū las skyes pa brgya phyed 'phreng ba'i 'dzin// 'jig rten zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'dus ma byas pa'i ri khrod ma// spros bral dri med rnam snang dbu la bzhugs// ṛ las 'khrungs pa gar gyis phyogs bcur gzigs// chu zla dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas dang nye gnas la sogs bgrod mdzad cing*// 'du byed ma lus srog mdzad tsaṇ+ḍā lī// rin chen dbu brgyan brjid pas ṝ las skyes// 'jig ma gsal mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje skyed mdzad g.yo ba'i ḍom+bi nī// sgeg mo snang mtha' dbu rgyan l̥ las byung*// mkha' ltar dri med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu drag po'i brda yis skad sbyor zhing*// ru dhi ra dang an+d+ra la rtag dgyes// zhe sdang rdo rje'i dbu rgyan l̥̄ las skyes// gau rī phyogs bcur gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings gsal ba'i yum gyur chom rkun ma// mi rtog mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i don la brtson// dbu rgyan gti mug rdo rje mi 'gyur rtags// e las skyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten ma lus chags pas dbang du mdzad// dpal ldan gzi brjid bskyed mdzad baitā lī// nga rgyal rdo rjes dbu brgyan e las skyes// snyoms 'jug mi gnas ngang la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab thabs su ldan pa'i ghasma rī// de nyid las skyes 'dod chags rdo rje'i brgyan// o las byung ba drag po'i las las skyes// skye med skye bar bstan la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyu ma smig rgyu bzhin du mkha' la spyod// bar snang mnga' mdzad he ru ka yi ngang*// cod pan snang ba mtha' yas au las skyes// thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan sa 'og spyod// 'og gi 'jig rten ma lus sgrol mdzad ma// aṃ las byung ba'i dur khrod 'jigs pas brgyan// thabs mkhas thugs rje can phyag 'tshal lo// ā li kā li zla ba nyi ma kha sbyor sa 'og rnam par dag pa las// gri gug thod pa la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan pa mdzes mdzad cing*// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar ldan gcer bu spyan gsum stag lpags sham thabs can// phyag rgya chen po'i sku ni rtsa gsum sprul mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

de nas spos kyi reng bu thogs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo bdag med ma// he ru ka dpal yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul ldan// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ ( sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes bya'o/) /gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bco lnga/ las bum dang bcas pa'am/ ma 'byor na bum pa gnyis gu gul gyis bdug bum rdzas so lnga dang ldan pas chu gtsang mas sum gnyis dgang*/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul pa bcings/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ bum mtshan gdags/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i steng du me tog gcal du bkram pa la lha dgod pa'i go rim bzhin du bzhugs su gsol/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa byang shar mtshams su bzhag bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa lnga tshang bar bsham/ de nas gtso bum gyi shing lo'i khar bdud rtsi dang chang sbyar bas bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag de'i steng du rdo rje'i lte bar me tog gi 'phreng ba brgyus pa'i gzungs thag btags te/ bum pa shu n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi'i dbyibs bum pa nang gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po nang skor 'dab ma bzhi/ phyi skor 'dab ma brgyad/ steng 'og gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus dang pad 'dab so so la dbugs bral dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma bdag med ma/

shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai tā lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha ba rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad sku mdog nag mo/ khro ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon par brten pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i ā las 'od zer 'phros/

ye shes kyi lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ=

zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo puk+ka sī gau rī rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma ri khrod ma chom rkun ma sa spyod ma rnams la rnam snang*/ dkar mo gdol pa mo ro langs ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma ḍom+bo nī ghasma rī mkha' spyod ma rnams la snang mtha'/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan nas gnyis su med par gyur/ bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyis sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha rnams kyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/ de rnams kyis lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/ bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yā= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= ces mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ// dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang nas bdag dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la bstod par gyur/ bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur// phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug gis mnan 'gror bltas te// 'gro ba gti mug zhi ba'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi gau rīr mdzad// de bas gau ri bstod phyag 'tshal// zhe sdang gis mnan 'gra ra bltas nas// 'gro la zhe sdang zhi bya'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi tsau rīr mdzad// de bas tsau rir bstod phyag 'tshal// nga rgyal gyis mnan 'gror bltas nas// 'gro ba nga rgyal zhi ba'i phyir// gtso bos be tā li gzugs mdzad// de bas be tā khyod phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags kyis dkrugs 'gror bltas nas// 'gro ba 'dod chags zhi bya'i phyir// gtso bos ghasma ri gzugs mdzad// de bas ghasma rī bstod 'dud// bdag med ma dang gnyis med gzugs// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum bdag// rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal//

zhes pas bstod/ bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi phul/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i nang du song zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byang chub sems kyis bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes gtso 'khor gyi snying po brgya la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi bum par blug pas bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ las bum shū n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi'i dbyibs bum pa gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i nang du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/

khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pūṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sogs nai wīd+yā āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod pa lngas mchod/ thugs kar nyi dkyil la hūm̐ sngon po las sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mi bzhu bar sku las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang lha de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las ma grub kyi bar du bgegs ma rungs pa rnams srung bar mdzad du gsol// zhes 'phrin las bcol lo// grub na dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon la chos bcu gnyis las/ dang por slob ma'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir in+d+ra'i sngags kyis gtor ma btang*/ de nas yol ba'i phyi rol tu las thams cad pa'i chus khrus bya gos gtsang ma gyon bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa 'jug pa ni/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gnas pa la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu mi gnyer te// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal//

zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab tu gzhug bzhi pa slob dpon gyis gsang sngags kyi theg par blo dgug par bya ba ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod tshul chog ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru ka /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/ ces brjod/ lnga pa nyan par rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang pos legs par nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces brjod/ drug pa rgyud dag par bya ba'i don du lnga rnam dag bya ba ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bya// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las grol// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de nyid du ni sems bskyed do/

/zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug bdun pa slob ma rab gnas ni/ slob ma skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med mar bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis dri bzang po'i chu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje lag tu thogs nas gnas gsum du mas rim gyis gtug cing*/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po cig sgoms shig ces brjod do// yang rdo rje yas rim gyis gtug cing*/ hūm̐ de rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥde pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ de 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par sgoms shig ces bya ste/ phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa de'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sku gsung thugs rdo rje bkug rang rang gi sa bon la bcug par sgoms shig/ de la slob dpon gyi mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod par bya'o// brgyad pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i don du so shing sbyin pa ni mchod sbyin gyi shing lcang ma'am shug pa'am 'om bu la sogs pa 'bus ma zos shing ma yo ba dang gas pa dang chag pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dri'i chus brlan zhing me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas te slob ma'i thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ mi smra ba ni so shing bca'// bca' zhing de bzhin mi dwags ? shing*// phan tshun du yang mi 'dor ro// so shing mdun du drang por dor/ /zhes bshad pas kha shar phyogs su bltas la so shing gi rtsa ba cung zad 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas mgo mjug bsgyur la rtse mo 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas rtsa bas so drud pa'i tshul du gyis la rtse mo gyen du bstan pa maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor zhig de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa ni/ de yi tshe na mtshan ma ni// de tshe bdag la blta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du bsgreng gyur na// de ni dngos grub mchog ces bshad// de bzhin shar du blta na ni/

de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'thob// so shing 'dor ba rgya zhig la// gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi /dngos grub de la the tshom med/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis brtag par bya'o// dgu pa khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang po'i chu khyor bar lan gsum sngags 'dis 'thung du gzhug ste/

oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsar+b+ba pā pa ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sar+b+ba bi kalpan a pa nā ya hūm̐/ des rnam par rtog pa thams cad sbyang bar bya'o// bcu pa rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i don du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po dri chus bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas pa'i nyung ba sngas dang mang ba stan gyi don du sbyin no// bcu gnyis pa bar chad bsrung ba'i don du srung skud gdags pa ni/ skud pa dmar po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i srung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su gdags/ de la dri'i chus byug bcu gnyis pa spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir zab rgyas kyi chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par// thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yin// bskal pa grangs med mang por ni// sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /zhes brjod/ nus na dge sbyor gyis/ mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs su rdo rje bdag med ma yid la gyis la nyol la rmi lam du gang rmis pa de nang par nga la smros shig ces brjod la gnas khang de nyid du nyal du gzhug go /de nas slob dpon yol ba'i nang du zhugs te dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ dge ba bsngo ba/ 'dod don gsol ba rnams byas te yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ mar me dang spos mtshan thub phul te ci bde bar nyal lo// nangs par slob dpon gyis rmi lam ci rmis zhes dris/ des kyang ji ltar rmis pa smra'o// ltas brtag pa ni rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong ba na/

zhes sogs byung na bzang*/ mun nag btson rar tshud pa sogs byung na ngan pas de rnams bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang bsres pa'i btung ba la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags btab pa 'thung du bcug pas kyang bzlog bdud rtsi lnga'i chu 'thung du bcug pa dang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam ltar yid la byed du bcug pa dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams kyis kyang bzlog go /gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po thig tshon gyi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sngar btegs med na badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha zhes pas nam mkhar bteg de nas bskyed rim yan lag drug ldan bsgoms te/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la las kyi he ru kar gyur nas shes rab ma mtshan dang ldan pa 'am/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis bkal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur longs pa'i tshon sna lnga'i skud pa/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang ldan na oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bde stong gi ngo bor byin gyis brlab/ rnam par rtog pa shas che na thod pa'i nang du bzhag des shū n+yatā sa bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skud pa sngon po a las bdag med ma nag mo/ dkar po āḥlas bdag med ma dkar mo/ ser po i las bdag med ma dmar mo/ dmar po ī bdag med dmar mo/ ljang khu e las bdag med ma ljang kha/ lnga ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag thugs kara'adzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasmā rī hoḥ oṃ dza hūm̐ sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bud med kyis 'dul sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lha 'od du zhu nas thig tu gyur/ thig skud rnams grogs dang bcas te bsgril nas ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/

slob dpon shar na gnas pas dzaḥdzaḥ zhes thig gi sna grogs kyi lag tu gtad/ des kyang skud pa'i sna gzung la rgyab nas bskor te nub tu song la/ sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ thig skud kyi sgras 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la khyed kyi sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus yin no zhes bskul bar bsams la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du bskor te grogs lho dang slob dpon rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas gnyis pa/ de nas grogs kyis rgyab nas bskor te dbang ldan dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te mer 'dug la shar gyi logs thig slob mas bskor te bden bral dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te rlung du gnas pas nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang grogs kyis bskor te dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi thig slob dpon gyis rgyab nas bskor te me dang grogs kyis bskor te bden bral du gnas pas lho thig slob dpon de nyid dang grogs rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon bden bral dang grogs dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams gdab cing chad pa dang ring thung phyogs 'khrul sogs nyes skyon dang bral bar bya/ de ltar thig chen brgyad gnam thig tu gdab bo// thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ las thig man ngag bzhin gdab/ tshon thig bzhin byin gyis brlab/ pra brtag pa ni 'khor lo'i dbus su 'dug ste kha phyir blta bas byang shar gyi mtshams su phyi mthar dkar po/ de nas ser dmar ljang nag po rnams 'khyid gang tsam g.yon pas 'then/ thod pa steng du bkab ste de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol ba// rgyal chen bdag med rnal 'byor ma'i// dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya// zhes brjod de me tog gcig gtor la/ thams cad mnyam zhing bar chad med// ngan pa dang ni nyams pa dang*// ma snyoms pa dang bar chad na// gnod pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa ltar tshon pra brtag

de nas lte ba nas rim par man ngag bzhin bris nas thig skud dang tshon lhag ma'i ye shes pa gshegs par bya'o// de nas lag len bzhin bri/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan pa ni/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bar bsags la lag len bzhin du nye bar brgyan par bya'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gsum las/ dang po mdun bskyed ni/ slob dpon bdag nyid khrus byas/ khar bdud rtsi ril bu bcug rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshangs can bting ba la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ 'byung gtor byin gyis brlab pa nas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i bar dkyil chog gi gong du 'byung ba ltar bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi'i bsangs gtor dkyil 'khor la byas pas/ thugs phyag mtshan rnams bkod pa la phog pas bdud rtsi'i thig ler gyur/ de las rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi ngang nas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ drug pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ bdun pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ de'i dbus su pad 'dab bzhi/ de'i phyi rol tu brgyad/ lte ba nag po/ ze'u 'bru khra bo/

'dab ma rnams dmar po/ gong ras nag po/ thod 'phreng dkar po/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pas bskor ba'i lte ba dang 'dab ma steng 'og tu ro gan rkyal tu bsgyel ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus dang 'dab ma so sor rdo rje gri gug thig le'i rnam par gnas pa de yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai tā lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha ba rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad sku mdog nag mo/ khro bo'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon par brten pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa/

mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyang dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur/(gong du sta gon ma byas na sta gon gyi lha bstim pa 'di mi dgos/) zhes mdun bskyed sgrub/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa'i don du/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ tshogs bsags nas brtsams bdag bskyed dkyus ltar gyi kha dog drug gis rgyas gdab kyi mthar de nas sngar bzhin gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i 'phros mngal 'byin gyi dus gtso mo'i thugs ka'i sa bon a las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor bkug bdag nyid kyi zhal du bcug ste pad+ma'i nang nas phyir phyung ste dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs su gsal bar gyur/ zhes sbyar ro// de nas gtso mo'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba zhal nas thon te lte bar bzhugs// gtso mo'i bzlas pas 'khor rnams zlos grogs byed par bsam/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ lha mo bcu bzhi rang gi snying ga'i sa bon la bsdu/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i ā las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/

oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo puk+ka sī gau rī rnams la mi bskyod pa/

rdo rje ma ri khrod ma chom rkun ma sa spyod ma rnams la rnam snang*/ dkar mo gdol pa mo ro langs ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma ḍom+bo nī ghasma rī mkha' spyod ma rnams la snang mtha'/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan nas gnyis su med par gyur/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhiṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum/ puk+ka sī dang gau ri ma la mi bskyod pa/ sha wa rī dang tsau rī ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang bai tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/

ḍom+bi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go /bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyis sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma konyahaṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha snam gyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/ de rnams kyis lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/
