bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yā= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= ces mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ bstod pa ni/ mi 'gyur ye shes gsal ba'i zhing khams nas// snang byed rdorje chos kyi 'khor lo las// khyab bdag bde chen 'byur gnas stong pa nyid// 'byung bzhi 'dres pa'i rin chen gzhal yas khang*// chu skyes dbugs bral gang snang gdan steng du// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med phyag mtshan las// ye shes lnga ldan gnyis med byang chub sems// don snang 'gag pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam shes rnam dag mi bskyod dbu la bzhugs// gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs srid dang zhi las 'das// skye med a las byon pa nam mkha'i mdog

'khor lo'i bdag mo gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs phung rnam dag rnam snang dbu la bzhugs// rmongs pa'i dri bral sgrib pa'i rtsa ba gcod// shes rab pha rol phyin don a las skyes// shar phyogs rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag rin 'byung brgyan// sgrib pa gnyis spangs ser sna'i rtsa rgyun gcod// i las skyes nas gsung gi sgra sgrog pa'i// lho phyogs gau rī ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'du shes phung po rnam dag snang mtha'i dbu// chags pa'i sgrib pa bde chen rol pas sbyong*// tshangs pa'i yi ge ī las 'khrungs pa yi// nub phyogs rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'du byed phung po rnam dag don brgyan// phrag dog kun bral byams pa'i thugs mnga' zhing*// u skyes u dum+ba ra'i 'od zer can// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// mi bskyod dbu brgyan sa khams rnam dag cing*// 'byung ba'i rang bzhin bde stong rol par shar// dri med dbyangs las ū la skur bzhengs pa'/ི /skye med puk+ka sī la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam snang dbu brgyan chu khams dag gyur pa'i// zag med rlan gyi thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren// rgyu 'bras tshul du ṛ las mtshan dpes brjid// snang byed ri khrod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rin 'byung dbu brgyan me khams rnam par dag ye shes 'bar 'phro'i thugs rje'i 'gro don mdzad// gsal stong ma 'gag sa bon ṝ las byon// bde chen tsaṇ+ḍa lī la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag med dbu brgyan rlung khams rnam dag cing*// thabs dang shes rab bskyod pas 'gro ba sgrol// dri bral ye shes li las skur bzhengs pa'i// don gzigs ḍoṃ bi nī la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs khams rnam dag sems dpas cod pan mdzes// zhe sdang spros bral byams pa'i ngang du dag mnyam nyid gzugs skus 'gro ba skam sar 'dren// l̥̄ las dbyer med gau rī ma la 'dud// sgra khams rnam dag rtag pa'i dbu brgyan can// gti mug ye shes gsal ba'i shes rab dang*// chos sgra gsung gi nga ros 'jig rten sgrog

/e yi rang bzhin chom rkun ma la 'dud// dri khams rnam dag rin chen rgyal pos spras// ser sna'i sgrib bral nam mkha' mdzod kyi ngang*// 'byor pa'i gsung gi phongs pa'i re ba skongs// ai las mtshungs med ro langs ma la 'dud// ro khams rnam dag 'od dpag med kyis brgyan// chags pa'i nyon mongs ye shes bde chen dang*// rtog med bcud kyi snying pos khams gsum khyab// o rang bzhin za phod ma la 'dud// reg bya rnam dag sku yi rdo rje brgyan// mi rtog chos dbyings las sprul yi ge au// sa 'og sems can ye shes thugs rjes 'dren// 'og phyogs 'gro 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rnam dag gsung gi rdo rje brgyan// bde chen 'byung gnas rgyu yi ge aṃ// bar snang nyi zla'i 'od bzhin thugs rje snyoms// steng phyogs 'gro 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yan lag drug sgom skye mched rnam par dag /rdo rje gsum mchog tshad med ye shes che// nyon mongs las rgyal 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// bco lnga'i tshul 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur chos dbyings rang bzhin sku mdog gnag// nyon mongs rtsad gcod g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin// 'chi bdag las rgyal g.yon pa pad+ma'i snod// bdud 'dul thod phreng can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dmar// rnam rtog rtsad gcod mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing*// ye shes me 'bar dbu skra gyen du brdzes// sku gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// 'ching bas ma bcings zhen med gcer bu'i tshul// rigs lngar rnam dag phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// 'khor ba las rgyal stag lpags sham bur bcas// g.yon brkyang ro sked bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// tha mal lus la lha yi skur rgyal zhing*// dug lnga ye shes lngar rgyal mkha' 'gro ma// gzung 'dzin bde stong ngo bo'i sa la sbyor// srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'bar bcas me yi dbus na 'gying mdzad cing*// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum gcig ma// bdag bskyed sems tshul 'jig rten gsum na khyab// lhan skyes 'khor lo bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dras khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las// dad pa'i shugs kyis chu thigs gcig blangs pa'i// srid pa rgya mtsho'i dug gsum rba rlabs bcom// blo ldan mya ngan 'das pa'i sa thob shog

/dran pas ma bral rgyun du khyed sgom pas// rtag tu ye shes skyes nas mi ldog lam// bde ba'i gling chen der ni bdag gzhan rnams// zung 'jug yangs pa'i yi dam khyed 'drar shog /khyod kyi yon tan shas tsam thos pas kyang*// srid dang ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel nus na// blo chung bstod pas mun pa'i smag tshogs la// ye shes gsal ba'i nyi ma 'char bar shog/ ces rje btsun rngog pas lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa byin rlabs can no/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa stu ti rabadz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ces bstod pas rgyas gdab bya/ tshogs kyi mchod pa skabs 'di'am bdag 'jug gi rjes su byas kyang rung*/ sgrub mchod zhag mang du sbrel na skabs 'dir bum bskyed/ bzlas pa/ las bum bcas sta gon skabs ltar bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ bdag nyid dbang blangs ba/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma sbyin pa/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i cho ga'o// de las dang po slob ma dkyil 'khor du dam tshig gi bdag nyid 'jug pa la/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ spos kyi reng bu thogs dril bu bsil zhing*/ dam tshig gi glus nye bar spyod par bya ba ni/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje 'dzin par bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa brtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag gi bdag /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog

/dbang phyug chen po rgyal bas rgyal// grub pa'i rdo rje cher gsal ba// rdo rje snyems par bdag sgrubs shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pas// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog/ de nas bden pa bsgrag par bya ste/ shes rab thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des// bdag gi 'dod pa skong gyur cig/ ces brjod do/ dam tshig glus bskul 'di bdag 'jug gi rjes su mdzad pa'ang phyag bzhes khungs mar 'byung*/ bzhi pa slob dpon bdag 'jug ni/ de nas bdag nyid kyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyi rol tu 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba ste/ sgrub pa'i grogs rtsa sngags bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi srung bar bzhag /slob dpon sogs dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyin cing sa phyogs gtsang mar dbus su mchod gtor/ g.yas su chu gnyis/ g.yon du mdun nas rgyab tu brtsams te nyer spyod phreng tshar/ mdun du nang mchod chu snod sogs 'du byas la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang gi steng du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bar du nag po dang*/ 'og tu dmar po rnams 'dab ma brgyad pa brtsegs pa/ rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas gzugs med srid pa'i lha tshogs nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i bar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsdus nas mdun gyi pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po cig tu gyur/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma la sogs pa 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma nag po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po cig tu gyur/ mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sa steng gi mi/ sa 'og gi klu/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su āḥdamar po cig tu gyur/

yi ge gsum po de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ pad+ma las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po rang 'od kyi rigs ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsum spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ gha sma rī hoḥ

zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod par bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/

oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dza la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ at+ma/ sarba/ kañdza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ pe ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod pas phul la/ dbang po mthar byed chu bdag dang*// nor sbyin dri za bden bral rlung*// 'byung po sa lha 'khor dang bcas// tshangs dang zla nyi la sogs gza'// gzhan yang tshangs ris dam pa dang*// tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa nyid// dga' ldan dang ni 'thab bral ba// rgyal po chen po bzhi yi ris// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams dang*// gang zhig 'phrul dga' yi ni lha// gtsang ma'i gnas na gang dag gnas// bde ba can na gnas rnams dang*// 'og min gnas na gnas pa dang*// 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gnas// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa rnams// klu chen stobs rgyu dung skyong dang*// de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas nyid// 'jog po dang ni rigs ldan te// pad chen pad+ma bzang po can// lha min sems can dmyal bar bcas// rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod/ /ces pas las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ nye reg bya zhing nang 'ong nas 'khod la/ khrus byas te maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la tshig rnams brjod pa dang dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su bdag nyid kyis slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang blang ngo*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal//

zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yog bsangs la bcings te/ rdo rje lag tu gtad de yol ba'i nang khrid par mos la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa spros te dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sngags/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṇāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta dharmā ṇāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṅgir/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mū la karma/ ban+dha naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la naṃ bā ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta kṛ tan+tā tra/ sarban+tu/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs kar gyis brdeg cing bgegs bskrad/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod su yin zhes dris la/ slob mas bdag skal ba bzang po can lags/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ de nas khyed rang rnams dang por shar phyogs kyi sgo yid kyis phye ste shar gyi lha snam du 'dug par mos la dkyil 'khor gyi la phyag mdzod cig oṃ na māste hūm̐/ oṃ na mā mi hūm̐/ oṃ na mo na mā mi hūm̐/ de bzhin du lho/ nub/ byang rnams nas kyang phyag bya'o/ /sems lha mo bco lnga'i zhabs la btud pa'i phyag byas pas shin tu mnyes par bsam mo// slar shar gyi lha snam du 'dug par mos la lnga rnam dag bya snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/

de yang dang po sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta ba// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan par gyur pa 'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni gzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya//

zhes pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang*/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs// de bas de la brnyas pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad// bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni// ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad// rdo rje spun la khros pa ni// nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin// sems can rnams la byams pa spong*// bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs// chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// de spong ba ni lnga pa yin// rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'// chos la smod pa drug pa yin// yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin// phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid// de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin// rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la// som nyi za ba dgu pa yin// gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par// byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod// ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la// der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa// sems can dad dang ldan pa la// sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa// dam tshig la ni ji bzhin brnyes// mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa// shes rab rang bzhin bud med la// smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa// sngags pas 'di dag spangs na ni// dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur// zhes rtsa ba'i dam tshig kyang dbog go /de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa bsgrags pa tsam gyis mi chog nges par khas blangs pa'i sgo nas bsrung dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces pas sdom pa khas len du gzhug de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med ma'i skur gsal thob byas la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ las bum gyi chus bsangs pa'i me tog 'phreng ba/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes thal mo'i bar du byin la snying gar bcang*/ slob dpon gyis snying gar rdo rje'i dri chu dang bcas pa gzung ste/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ zhes brjod nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la lha'i dam bsgrag pa 'di brjod par bya ste/ de ring khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la rdo rje bdag med ma'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ bdag med mkha' 'gro deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /mna' chu blud pa bdud rtsi ril bu chang dang sbyar ba thod par blug ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ to da ka hūm̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam bsgrag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal rdo rje bdag med ma nga yin gyis/ ngas gang byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig

/khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal bdag med ma bdag la phob cig/ ces lan gsum brjod du bcug la/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chu sbyin la/ 'o khyod rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su am̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' nas tshur/ oṃ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus pha gi na bcom ldan 'das ma sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon am̐ sngon po las 'od zer dkar po breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu ba la shes pa gtod la/ gzhan gang la'ang sems yengs su ma 'jug cig ces brjod la dril bu gsil zhing mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ sems la shar bar bsam/ gu gul gyis bdug snying po'i gsham la a āḥ zhes btags pa brjod/ sku gsung thugs phebs pa'i rtags byung na dang*/ ma byung na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la ye shes pa yang dang yang du bcug nas gong bzhin phab na phebs par 'gyur ro// phebs na de snang mtha' lce la a dmar po cig bsgoms te/ smos shig bu yis dge mi dge zhes brjod pas dge mi dge thams cad ston par 'gyur ro// slob dpon gyis spos chus brlan pa'i lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas nas/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar khrid de/ dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog ji lta bu mthong zhes dri/ des kyang dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang khu dang*/ nag po dang*/ khra bor mthong zhes smra na/
rim pa bzhin du/ zhi ba dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod dang*/ las thams cad pa 'grub pa'i snod du 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan no// de nas 'di skad du/

yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod la me tog gi 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor ro// de yang gtso bo la phog na mchog gi dngos grub/ 'khor rnams la thun mong gi dngos grub/ pho brang gi nang du tshud na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa yin la/ lan gsum bskyar yang pho brang gi nang du ma tshud na nges par skal pa med pa'o// de nas me tog gi 'phreng ba blangs la/ sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar bgyi// cesapas me tog gi 'phreng ba mgo la bcings/ slob ma'i mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ re bsgoms te/ rdo rje bdag med deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ces brjod pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad par rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs te// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang*// thams cad 'di la mngon du 'gyur// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyong*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus 'di na bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med ma bzhugs/ 'di na gau rī ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams bzhugs/ 'di ni lha snam/ 'di ni pañtsa re kha'i brtsig pa/ 'di ni sgo rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'di ni 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rin chen pha gu/ drwa ba drwa phyed/ 'di ni dur khrod chen po brgyad/ 'di ni rdo rje'i rwa ba dang me ri yin no// de las kyang khyod kyi me tog phog pa'i lha ni 'di yin no// zhes dkyil 'khor la dbyug gu sogs gtad cing bstan no// de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

dbang bzhi las bum dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// de ltar yon tan 'byung la sogs// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyid// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ shar phyogs su ba'i rnam lnga'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du slob ma bzhag /'khor lo'i bdag por bltas te/ steng du gdugs g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs kyis brgyan/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas las sngags kyis bsangs/ /rak+ṣas bsrungs la/ slob ma swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ 'khor gyi bum pa'i chu rnams gtso bo'i bum par bsdus te dngos su slob dpon gyis thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po pa// khams gsum kun gyis phyag 'tshal ba'i// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum las// rab tu byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag cing chu blug pa dang*/ kha gdong bkru ba dang*/ khyor gang 'thung du gzhug sems kyis/ mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pas dbang bskur bar bsam/ 'o khyod la chu'i dbang bskur bas kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// slob ma dang dbu rgyan las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgron ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbang rdzas la ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ yid kyis mchod/ swa rat+na dh+rika rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ slar dbu rgyan gyi gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste/ thor tsugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes mgor bskon la sems kyis/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar bsam/ khyod la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// de nas slob ma dang rdo rje bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsnang ba mtha' yas yab yum slar rdo rje'i gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes lag pa g.yas par gtad la/ sems kyis mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas rdo rje gtod par bsams la/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin/ slob ma dang dril bu bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdon yod grub pa yab yum slar dril bu'i gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ ti ṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya staṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yon par gtad la/ sems kyis mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas dril bu gtad par bsams/ dril bu'i dbang skur bas sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// slob ma bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i brdar/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣi ka ta/ kye dpal/ zhe sdang rdo rje zhes ming btags rdo rje bzhad pa dang*/ rdo rje rnam par sgrogs pa dang*/ rdo rje ldem pa/ skyes pa la'o// rdo rje snyems ma dang*/ rdo rje mtshon cha dang*/ rdo rje e ma ho bde ba dang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ bud med la/ gzhan yang rigs so so'i ming gdags so// sems kyis mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas ming btags par bsam/ ming gi dbang bskur bas ming gzhi'i phung po gnas gyur nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// de nas khyed rang rnams stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje

zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin sgom du bcug la/ gri gug dang thod pa dril bu btags pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'brel ba'i tshangs skud ḍā ma ru rnams bsangs sbyangs la/ a las byung ba'i gri gug shes rab kyi rang bzhin lag pa g.yon dang*/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i thod pa thabs bde ba'i rang bzhin lag pa g.yas su gtad/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gru mor bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// de rnams dang ldan pa ni/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rmongs par bya ba dang*/ dgra'i sde 'jigs pa dang bsad pa la sogs pa de rnams la thogs pa med par 'grub par byos shig mchil lahwam bgo ba dang*/ char dbab pa dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba gzung ba la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub thams cad ni ci dga' bar sgrub par gyis shig de ni las kyi tshogs dang thun mong dngos grub rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas dam tshig gsum gyi dbang sbyin pa ni/ slob ma rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur sgoms shig/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// lag pa g.yas par sbyin te/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dbyer med du rtogs par bya ba'i blos zung zhig snying khar 'dzin du bcug thugs kyi dam tshig go/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// lag pa g.yon du gtad/ des kyang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sems can thams cad la sgrog pa'i blos dkrol/ gsung gi dam tshig go/ khyed rang rnams me tog phog pa'i yi dam gyi lhar skad cig gis sgoms shig yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad// dam tshig yid ni brtan pa gang*// de phyir phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brjod la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byed du bcug la/ dus 'di nas gzung nas yi dam gyi lha dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar gyis shig sku'i dam tshig go/ slar khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad du sgoms shig /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig/ de bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ don grub rnams su sgoms shig byas la/ 'jig rten khams ni zhes sogs dang*/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig de bzhin 'gres te/ /rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya ser sna can rnams kyi don gyis shig pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig /las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ khyod kyis gdul bya le lo can rnams kyi don gyis shig /de dag ni rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba lnga ste/

sangs rgyas nas gdul bya dug lnga dang bcas pa'i sems can rnams la rigs lnga'i gzugs gzung nas gdul bya'i don tshegs med par 'byung ngo*// de nas slob dpon g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i snam sbyar gyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas la/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyed lung bstan yin// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ya staṃ/ bhur+bhu waḥswa/ khyod kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa ni gtso mo bdag med ma'o/ gzugs kyi phung po dang gti mug rnam par rnam dag pa ni lha mo rdo rje ma'o// tshor ba'i phung po dang ser sna rnam par dag pa ni lha mo dkar mo'o// 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags rnam par dag pa ni lha mo chu'i rnal 'byor ma'o// 'du byed kyi phung po dang phrag dog rnam par dag pa ni lha mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o// de dag nang gi 'phar ma'i lha mo lnga'o// rang gi lus kyi 'byung ba sa rnam par dag pa ni lha mo puk+ka sī'o// chu rnam par dag pa lha mo rngon mo'o// me rnam par dag pa ni lha gtum mo'o// rlung gi khams rnam par dag pa ni lha mo g.yung mo'o// mig gi yul du gzugs rnam par dag pa lha mo dkar mo'o// rna ba'i yul du sgra rnam par dag pa ni lha mo chom rkun ma'o// sna'i yul du dri rnam par dag pa ni lha mo ro langs ma'o// lus kyi yul du reg bya rnam par dag pa ni lha mo sa spyod ma'o// yid kyi yul du chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa ni lha mo mkha' spyod ma'o// mig gi dbang po dang mig gi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni gti mug rdo rje ma'o// rna ba'i dbang po dang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni zhe sdang rdo rje ma'o// sna'i dbang po dang sna'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni ser sna rdo rje ma'o// lce'i dbang po dang lce'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni 'dod chags rdo rje ma'o// lus kyi dbang po dang lus kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni phrag dog rdo rje ma'o// yid kyi dbang po dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni reg bya rdo rje ma yin pas khyod rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor lung bstan pa'o//

de ltar lung ma bstan par sngon bdag gis ma shes/ rang gi phung po khams skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor 'dug pas de re dga' snyam du mdzod// ces gzengs bstod/ bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'das pa'o// khyod ni tshe thog ma med pa nas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor/ ngal ba don med 'ba' zhig tu song*/ da ni bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ni thob pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad la 'jigs pa med par byos shig /thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pas nges par 'tshang rgya'o//

de nas/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po gzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes slob ma'i lag tu rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ des kyang sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bshad cing slob ma bsdu ba'i blos/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil bar bya'o/ /de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnang ba rjes su sbyin pa'o// de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gtad/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brten// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka ya s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad la/ de lan gsum du gsor te snying gar bzung du bcug la/ 'o khyod kyis 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa thams cad brtul nas gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par byos shig de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag khyad par lus kyi dri ma dag nas rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa dang bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba dang*// gtor ma gtang du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang rig ma phul la/ gsang ba'i dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te// bde gshegs rnams kyis bde stsol mdzad// byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi// yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa// ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis// mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin// de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal dag ni bsal bar mdzod// rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig nyes pa'i rab rib 'joms// gang gi bla med byang chub pa// de 'dir bdag gis thob par mdzod//

ces lan gsum brjod la/ slob dpon bdag nyid bdag med mar bskyed/ de la ye shes kyi lha mo bstim/ dbang bskur nas mchod/ de nas de'i snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ lkog ma/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu dri'i thig le byas/ de rnams su rim pa bzhin mi bskyod pa dang*/ don grub/ rdo rje 'chang*/ snang mtha'/ rin 'byung*/ rnam par snang mdzad rnams bsgoms la mchod/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir gdong ras dmar pos bcings la/ yid kyis slob dpon sgyu ma lta bu'i sku/ mos gus rtse gcig pas g.yon bskor lan gsum byas par soms shig byas la ye shes pa dbab pa'i don ni rang byin gyis brlab pa bstan pa/ kyai yi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa'i// de bzhin bdag gis sad mdzad pa// rdo rje mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bshad kyis 'dod pas rab tu nyon// lha mo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur// rangs par gyur te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung nyan to// zhes bshad/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du me tog gtor la/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa ni// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ bum pa'i dbang gi dus su phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin la de bas zab pa 'di rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa yin// zhes pas/ slob dpon bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med mar gnas pa'i thugs ka na mi bskyod pa/ dpral ba na rin chen 'byung ldan// lte ba na don yod grub pa/ mgrin pa na snang ba mtha' yas/ gsang ba'i gnas na rdo rje 'chang*/

spyi bo na rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa yin no// zhes lus kyi lha ngo bstan la sngar gyi me tog phog pa'i ming gis gdags so/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid 'od kyi thabs he ru ka dang snyoms par 'jug pa byas te thig le phyung bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal byas la 'o ma dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyar te mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyis// do nub khyod la dbang bskur ro// a hoḥsu kha/ zhes brjod la/ byang chub sems kyi thig le de khyod rang rnam pa'i lce thog tu skya phung yod par sgoms la lce yar rkan la sbyar te/ rtsa a wa dhū tī mda' smyug tsam pa'i mar sna rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo dang*/ yar sna lce'u chung la zug pa'i nang na mar byang chub sems kyi thig le lce thog tu skya chi li li song bas lus thams cad la bde ba phri li li skyes par bsgom/ zag pa med pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi don la shes pa lhan ne gtod cig khrag chen po ni ga pur bcas// tsan dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar// de bzhin rdo rje chu dang bcas// lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun dang mthun par gsungs// dam tshig 'di ni bla na med// bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya// zhes dam tshig phog la mig dar bsal lo/ /des spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag khyad par ngag gi dri ma dag nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang*/ zas kyi rnal 'byor byar rung ba dang*/ rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rdzogs rim bsgom du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang gsum pa'i don du byang chub sems kyis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum zlum skor gnyis kyi nang mdzes par lha mo bco lnga'i tshom bu bkod/

lha bskyed mchod pa dang tshogs kyis mnyes par byas/ de nas slob mas yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor ci bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la de stsol cig /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs dag tu// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum brjod la chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir gdong g.yogs bcings la/ chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor lan gsum yid kyis byas par mos la ye shes dbab pa ni/ khyed rang rnam pa'i rkang pa gnyis gshibs kyis gshibs la langs te lus thang sha bcad la thal mo sbyar nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dbang po lnga'i 'jug shes bsdus te/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su mi shigs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam de la rlung bcug ste ma yengs par bya'o// de'i don snying ga'i dbus na zla ba gnas// zla ba'i gzugs las mi shigs pa// sna tshogs 'od kyi rnam 'khrigs ldan// des na rdo rje rnam par bsgoms// rdo rje bdag med ma mkha' 'gro// bskul ba'i cho ga bsgom par bya'o// mkha' 'gro ma yi sna rtser ni// yungs kar rnam par gnas par bsgom// khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i// 'gro ba ma lus yungs kar du'o// de lta bur ni bsgoms gyur na// rang byin brlab pa rab tu 'grub// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du me tog dor la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs//

zhes gsungs pas// gsang dbang gi dus su slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ de bas zab pa 'di chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor yin/ de yang chos 'byung gis ni bde stong mtshon la// de na bzhugs pa'i lha yang bde stong dbyer med las ma 'das par bstan to/ /zhes chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du lha ngo bstan la/ rdo rje snyems ma zhes sogs kyi ming gis gdags so/ /de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje zhal phyag rgyan cha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od kyi rig ma lha mo bdag med ma phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa shin tu mdzes shing gzhon sha chags pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam pa zhig byung nas khyed rang rnams la gtad par gyur/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes brjod la/ de dang snyoms par 'jug pa byas pas dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes par sgoms shig yang khyed rang rnam pa'i lte ba na gtum mo ye shes kyi me reg bya tsha ba rno ba gdung ba cig dmar nar gyis 'bar ba la shes pa gtod la bde ba phri li li skyes par sgoms shig byas la/ slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i rtsa rba rlabs btsir la sgom du bcug pas rtogs pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod cing lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes shar bas dbang bskur ba zhes bya'o/ /des spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /khyad par sems kyi dri ma dag nas chags can gyis las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa dang*/ chags bral gyis lha zhal sbyar gyi bskyed rim dang gtum mo bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la tshig dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

rdo rje 'chang chen bka' drin gyis// 'dir ni dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// stong nyid shes rab mdzes pa yi// bzhi pa'i bka' drin stsal tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de ltar dbang gsum pa'i dus su spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar gtan la phab nas/ bzhi par tshig gis gtan la dbab pa ni/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad// rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par byang ba dag /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// mchog dgar bsgom pa med cing sgom pa po yang med// lus kyang med cing gzung ba med cing 'dzin pa'ang med// sha dang khrag kyang med cing bshang dang gci ba'ang med// skyug bro rmongs med gtsang sbra mchod phyir thogs med dang*// chags med sdang ba med dang rmongs med phrag dog med// ser sna med dang nga rgyal med cing mthong bya med// bsgom dang sgom pa med cing bshes dang dgra med dang*// rlom sems med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa sna tshogs nyid// ces pa dang*/ ye shes 'di ni che phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha' dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar 'byin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas phyag rgya chen po sgom du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i steng du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bar du nag po dang*/ 'og tu dmar po rnams 'dab ma brgyad pa brtsegs pa rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas gzugs med srid pa'i lha tshogs nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i bar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsdus nas mdun gyi pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po cig tu gyur/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma la sogs pa 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma nag po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po cig tu gyur/

mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sa steng gi mi/ sa 'og gi klu/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su āḥdamar po cig tu gyur/ yi ge gsum po de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ pad+ma las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsum spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥ/tsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+yā= ā lo ke=

lngas mchod/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dza la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ āt+ma/ sarba/ kañdza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ pe ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams mnyes nas ha ha/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥzhes ye shes kyi gad mo bcu gnyis sgrogs shing*/ sgrub pa po khyod kyi yid la ci 'dod pa bdag cag rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o zhes khas len par gyur/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams=

yi dwags tshogs= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed tshogs= brjed byed tshogs= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// dbang dang mngon spyod dgra 'joms dang*// dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs shog/

ces phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥgator ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas chos skyong lcam dral gyi gtor ma gtong*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa gong du ma gtang na 'dir bya'o// de nas las kyi he ru kas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ kyai gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes lan gsum gyis rtog pa dgrol/ slob dpon gyis/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yi// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a hoḥsu khaṃ/ brjod cing tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i kha phru btab la/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis lhag ma'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di hab di ri ri gsol bar gyur/ dur khrod bdag mo brjod gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ shin tu lhag ma bsdus te bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ 'byung po phud la mi re zhing lhag ma la dbang ba phyi rol sgo gdong na gnas pa rnams la sbyin no// so so zas skom gyis tshims par gyur cig /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig de nas kol+la i reṭ+ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/

kā ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro la/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī ga ḍeṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ du na dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tsha tu ri si h+la kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in+dha ṇa sā li dza/ ta he bhi ru kha i a i/ pheṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṅga tsa ḍi wi/ ta hiṃ sa ra wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a tso kun+tu ru bā ḍa i ḍaṃ ṇ+ḍi ma te hiṃ ṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i// ces mngon rtogs bzhin du rdo rje'i glu blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ slob ma rnams kyis bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya zhing yig brgya brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod par bya ste/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ baitā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rā shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ= zhes mchod / sgrub mchod kyi nyin tha mar tshigs bcad bcas rgyas par bya'o/ /bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur// phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug gis mnan 'gror bltas te// 'gro ba gti mug zhi ba'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi gau rīr mdzad// de bas gau ri bstod phyag 'tshal// zhe sdang gis mnan 'gror bltas nas// 'gro la zhe sdang zhi bya'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi tsau rīr mdzad// de bas tsau rir bstod phyag 'tshal// nga rgyal gyis mnan 'gror bltas nas// 'gro ba nga rgyal zhi ba'i phyir// gtso bos be tā li gzugs mdzad// de bas be tā khyod phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags kyis dkrugs 'gror bltas nas// 'gro ba 'dod chags zhi bya'i phyir// gtso bos ghasma ri gzugs mdzad// de bas ghasma rī bstod 'dud// bdag med ma dang gnyis med gzugs// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum bdag// rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal// kun tu sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong zhing*// sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo//

ces dang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ zhes pas bstod// de nas lhag chad bskong ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ gtso bo nus pa mchis shing*// ma tshang ba dang lhag gyur dang*// gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams// de kun bzod par mdzad par rigs// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang*// de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med rnal 'byor ma dpal ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog/ ces brjod rang don gyi thun mtshams thams cad kyi mthar ye shes sems dpa' mi gshegs la/ gzhan don thams cad kyi thun mtshams su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba rje btsun nā ro pa'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa'o// de nas/ he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥmadun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams// 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyi rten la bstim pa'am rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rdul tshon gyi nub tha ma la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsal// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra mu/ zhes pa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma

'am yang na he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur bar mngon rtogs bzhin no// rdul tshon a kā ro 'i sngags kyis 'phyag la klu chog gis chu bor dor/ thig dang bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams mi mngon par bya'o// bla ma la yon phul/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen til+li nā ro dang*// mar pa chos rdor mdo sde kun dga' dang*// gzi brjid grags pa rin bzang chos rgyan sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bkra shis shog /thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// chags pas 'dul mdzad bdag med ma la 'khyud// gdul bya'i dbang gis gar dgu'i rol pa mdzad/ bcom ldan dgyes rdor sku yi bkra shis shog /mgon po bde chen sku dang gnyis med yum// lha mo bdag med mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gtso// bha ga'i dbyings nas lha mo'i tshogs sprul ma// rdo rje bdag med ma yi bkra shis shog /gzugs sogs phung po bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// ye shes rnam pa bzhi yi rang bzhin can// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs bzhi sbyong ba// sgo bzhi'i lha mo rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med bzhi yi rang bzhin can// mgon po bde chen thugs ni skul mdzad ma// mtshams bzhi'i lha mo rnams kyi bkra shis shog de ltar bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i cho ga 'di yang pad+ma dkar pos rtse chen pho brang du mar rngog ḍom+bi pa sogs kyi lugs bzhin du bkod pa thams cad la bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma mngon sum du 'byung bar gyur cig yum bka' la brgyud pa gzhan yab bka' bzhin la/ rgyal dbang rje/ a ba dhū tī pa/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ chos kyi grags pa/ sngags 'chang tshe bdag bkra shis/ des bdag go /slad nas bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' stsal ltar dbang bskur sgrub mchod sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du dmigs te kun mkhyen rjes dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'ang 'don pa cung zad sgyur ba las yab bka' dang khyad par med ces gsungs pa khungs su byas shing dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung la sgo bstun nas
